cap-environment-setup.one_line: Which environments exist, how many, and how each is set up.

fn-declare-environments.one_line: Declares which environments the project has, at least dev, testing and pre-production and never production, and for each one its data, its size, its network, who can reach it and its own settings, so every deployment and every test runs in a place that was set up on purpose.

fn-build-environment.one_line: When a deployment needs an environment that is not built yet, builds it on its own from the one design of the underlying technology and its declaration, after a person's yes, checks that it answers, and from then on keeps it apart from the others until a person asks to take it down.

fn-update-environments.one_line: When the project needs another environment, or an environment's data, size, network, access or settings must change, a person confirms an update, and what held before stays readable with why it changed.

fn-dev-sandbox.one_line: Sets up a place on a builder's own machine where the builder runs the project's code while building it, with each part running on the machine itself and no container platform or cloud service needed, so a builder can try a change before it goes to dev.
